RI=50% of chimeric mouse livers is the turning point to have humanized function, and the RI is the most accurate index for humanized liver function of chimeric animals.

the characterization of humanized liver function from chimeric mouse using COH as a probe.
the development of a humanized mouse model with human CYP2As and hAlb.
the characterization of chimeric mouse models with humanized liver functions using coumarin and benzaldehyde as probes.

RI=50% of chimeric mouse liver is the threshold for the liver function to be humanized.

RI>50% is the minimum requirement to obtain a chimeric mouse with humanized liver function.
